# Hamropedia

> Hamropedia (hamropedia.com) is a free website by Manoj Kumar Thapa, an AI software engineer in Birmingham, UK. It has sourced, dated guides for Nepali students going abroad, Nepal news explainers, four free courses (AI & ML, System Design, SQL, DSA) and free Nepali tools. Every article links to the official or named sources it is based on.

## Study abroad guides
- [NOC online in Nepal](https://hamropedia.com/noc-online-nepal/): how to apply for the No Objection Certificate, documents by level, the NRs 2,000 fee and status check
- [WES application from Nepal](https://hamropedia.com/wes-application-from-nepal/): every screen of the form, sending TU and KU transcripts to WES
- [WES evaluation cost](https://hamropedia.com/wes-evaluation-cost/): every fee in US$, C$ and Nepali rupees, ICAP vs Basic, Canada ECA
- [UK student visa from Nepal](https://hamropedia.com/uk-student-visa-from-nepal/): requirements, fees, funds and costs in rupees
- [UK Graduate visa: 18 months or 2 years](https://hamropedia.com/uk-graduate-visa-two-years-high-compliance-universities/)
- [ILR new rules: indefinite leave to remain in 5 or 10 years](https://hamropedia.com/ilr-changes-uk-5-year-vs-10-year-route-earned-settlement/)
- [UKVI credibility interview questions and answers](https://hamropedia.com/top-ukvi-interview-question-examples-and-answers/)
- [EDV 2027 (DV lottery) status for Nepal](https://hamropedia.com/edv-2027-nepal-dv-lottery-open-date/)

## Nepal
- [Balen Shah, prime minister of Nepal: from the Gen Z protests to power](https://hamropedia.com/nepal-gen-z-protests-to-balen-shah-government-explained/)

- [Nepali news in Nepali](https://hamropedia.com/ne/)

## Free courses
- [AI & Machine Learning roadmap](https://hamropedia.com/ai-roadmap/): 98 lessons, from NumPy to LLMs, RAG and agents
- [System Design](https://hamropedia.com/system-design/): 72 lessons on high-level design, low-level design and AI/ML design
- [SQL](https://hamropedia.com/sql/): 61 lessons with a query runner in the browser
- [DSA: the NeetCode 150](https://hamropedia.com/dsa/): 18 patterns and 150 problems
- [Learn & Build](https://hamropedia.com/learn/): where to start

## Free tools
- [Nepali typing: English to Nepali Unicode](https://hamropedia.com/tools/english-to-nepali/)
- [Preeti to Unicode converter](https://hamropedia.com/tools/preeti-to-unicode/)
- [Nepali keyboard (Nepali Unicode Traditional layout, close to Preeti)](https://hamropedia.com/tools/nepali-keyboard/)
- [Nepali date converter (BS to AD)](https://hamropedia.com/tools/nepali-date-converter/)
- [DV lottery photo checker and editor: check the photo, crop to 600x600 JPEG under 240 kB, live head-size check](https://hamropedia.com/tools/dv-photo-tool/)
